cases.question: Show total sales and order count for Hasan

oracle.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.net_amount), 0) AS total_sales, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM analytics_orders o JOIN analytics_salespersons s ON s.id = o.salesperson_id WHERE o.workspace_id = ? AND o.status = 'completed' AND s.name = ?;

cases.question: Show sales amount and order count for each salesperson for the last 7 days

oracle.sql: SELECT s.name AS salesperson, COALESCE(SUM(o.net_amount), 0) AS sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM analytics_orders o JOIN analytics_salespersons s ON s.id = o.salesperson_id AND s.workspace_id = ? WHERE o.workspace_id = ? AND o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC;

cases.question: Show collection amount grouped by payment method

oracle.sql: SELECT p.payment_method, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS total_collected FROM analytics_payments p WHERE p.workspace_id = ? GROUP BY p.payment_method ORDER BY total_collected DESC;

cases.question: Show total revenue and quantity sold for each product category

oracle.sql: SELECT pr.category, COALESCE(SUM(oi.subtotal), 0) AS product_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS product_quantity FROM analytics_order_items oi JOIN analytics_products pr ON pr.id = oi.product_id AND pr.workspace_id = ? JOIN analytics_orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.workspace_id = ? WHERE o.workspace_id = ? AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY pr.category ORDER BY product_revenue DESC;

cases.question: Gotokal Hasan total koto takar order complete korse?

oracle.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.net_amount), 0) AS sales_amount FROM analytics_orders o JOIN analytics_salespersons s ON s.id = o.salesperson_id AND s.workspace_id = ? WHERE o.workspace_id = ? AND o.status = 'completed' AND DATE(o.order_date) = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND s.name = ?;

cases.question: Aj Tarek koto taka collect korse?

cases.question: Show total collections and number of payments today

oracle.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS collection_amount, COUNT(p.id) AS payment_count FROM analytics_payments p WHERE p.workspace_id = ? AND DATE(p.collected_at) = CURRENT_DATE();

cases.question: What is Hasan's average order value?

oracle.sql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(o.net_amount), 0), 2) AS average_order_value FROM analytics_orders o JOIN analytics_salespersons s ON s.id = o.salesperson_id AND s.workspace_id = ? WHERE o.workspace_id = ? AND o.status = 'completed' AND s.name = ?;

cases.question: Hasan bkash-e koto taka collect korse?

oracle.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS collection_amount FROM analytics_payments p JOIN analytics_salespersons s ON s.id = p.salesperson_id AND s.workspace_id = ? WHERE p.workspace_id = ? AND s.name = ? AND p.payment_method = ?;

cases.question: Top 3 customers having outstanding due greater than 10000

oracle.sql: SELECT c.name, (COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.net_amount) FROM analytics_orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'completed'), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM analytics_payments p WHERE p.customer_id = c.id), 0)) AS due_amount FROM analytics_customers c WHERE c.workspace_id = ? HAVING due_amount > ? ORDER BY due_amount DESC LIMIT 3;

cases.question: Tarek-er active due recovery assignment koyti?

oracle.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_assignments FROM analytics_due_assignments a JOIN analytics_salespersons s ON s.id = a.assigned_salesperson_id WHERE a.workspace_id = ? AND s.name = ? AND a.status IN ('assigned', 'in_progress');

cases.question: How many units of Ergonomic Office Chair did Hasan sell?

oracle.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS product_quantity FROM analytics_order_items oi JOIN analytics_products pr ON pr.id = oi.product_id AND pr.workspace_id = ? JOIN analytics_orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.workspace_id = ? JOIN analytics_salespersons s ON s.id = o.salesperson_id AND s.workspace_id = ? WHERE o.workspace_id = ? AND o.status = 'completed' AND s.name = ? AND pr.name = ?;

cases.question: Show revenue from Electronics category in the last 7 days

oracle.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.subtotal), 0) AS product_revenue FROM analytics_order_items oi JOIN analytics_products pr ON pr.id = oi.product_id AND pr.workspace_id = ? JOIN analytics_orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.workspace_id = ? WHERE o.workspace_id = ? AND o.status = 'completed' AND pr.category = ? AND o.order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY);

cases.question: How much more or less did we sell today compared to yesterday?

oracle.sql: SELECT ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(net_amount), 0) FROM analytics_orders WHERE workspace_id = ? AND order_date = CURRENT_DATE() AND status = 'completed') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(net_amount), 0) FROM analytics_orders WHERE workspace_id = ? AND order_date = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND status = 'completed')) AS sales_difference;

cases.question: Kon customer Hasan-er under-e sobcheye beshi baki ache?

oracle.sql: SELECT c.name, (COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.net_amount) FROM analytics_orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.salesperson_id = (SELECT id FROM analytics_salespersons WHERE name = ? AND workspace_id = ?) AND o.status = 'completed'), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM analytics_payments p WHERE p.customer_id = c.id), 0)) AS due_amount FROM analytics_customers c WHERE c.workspace_id = ? AND c.id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM analytics_orders WHERE salesperson_id = (SELECT id FROM analytics_salespersons WHERE name = ? AND workspace_id = ?)) ORDER BY due_amount DESC LIMIT 1;

cases.question: Currently total koto taka baki powna ache overall?

oracle.sql: SELECT ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(net_amount), 0) FROM analytics_orders WHERE workspace_id = ? AND status = 'completed') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM analytics_payments WHERE workspace_id = ?)) AS total_outstanding_due;

cases.question: Total kotojon customer er due recovery assigned ache?
